findings: Reflecting Space II:Fantasia and Berceuse,composed2007–2008,12min,saxophone and electronics;commissioned Masanori Oishi. Composer work catalog gives2007–2008,while current Zen-On page shortens to2008.
Premiere11March2008,Tokyo Opera City,Masanori Oishi,per Zen-On. IRCAM date11March2006 conflicts with its own2007–2008composition range;do not use2006premiere.

A2010academic report on live-electronics performance describes four-channel real-time Max/MSP processing:record/playback,delay,harmonization,FM,granular synthesis,filtering,phase vocoder and sound-file playback; saxophonist advances events via MIDI pedal.

IRCAM specifies at least four loudspeakers around audience,computer,mixing/amplification,microphones and MIDI pedal. Composer sound page lists two exact Oishi extracts at Parthenon Tama,within embedded SoundCloud playlist.

Kyoto City University of Arts programmed this work in a2017lecture-concert for a recording/electronic-music class,Haruka Inoue saxophone and Sumihisa Arima electronics. Zen-On score availability is by inquiry.
